# Live-model validation

[English](README.md) | [日本語](../../../ja/test_case/online/README.md) | [Français](../../../fr/test_case/online/README.md) | [中文](../../../../test_case/online/README.md)

<!-- Generated by npm run docs:localize; edit docs/i18n/translations.json. -->

Run online scripts explicitly from the repository root with specified role models, existing credentials, and a new private evidence directory. Each run follows its script budget and records actual HTTP requests, usage, timing, first failures, and independent verification. Ordinary `npm test` runs offline regressions.

## API v1 scenarios

Configure an existing role-credential file with separate main/task keys:

```sh
export SECRETARY_MODE=live
export SECRETARY_MAIN_PROVIDER=opencode-go
export SECRETARY_MAIN_MODEL='<主模型>'
export SECRETARY_TASK_PROVIDER=opencode-go
export SECRETARY_TASK_MODEL='<任务模型>'
export SECRETARY_CREDENTIALS_FILE='<已有私密凭据文件>'
node --import tsx test_case/online/test-api-v1-live.ts --self-check
node --import tsx test_case/online/test-api-v1-live.ts --live --scenario memory-restart --evidence '<全新私密目录>'
```

| Scenario | Validation scope | Default budget |
| --- | --- | --- |
| test-api-v1-live.ts, default | Main session, tasks, settings, compaction, and reopening | 12 HTTP requests, 15 minutes |
| `--scenario task-chain` | Two rounds of one task and parent-execution identity; numeric results come from the model summary | 12 requests, 10 minutes |
| `--scenario memory-restart` | Real compaction, old OS process exit, new PID/Core instance, recall in the same data domain | 12 requests, 10 minutes; preparation at most 10 requests |
| test-api-v1-artifacts-live.ts | Real tools, four artifact downloads, and independent arithmetic/program verification | 12 requests, 10 minutes; request starts at least 20 seconds apart |

These scenarios default to 90 seconds per request, 4096 output tokens, and 80000 bytes of context. Budgets count actual provider HTTP sends; failed directories are retained. self-check validates positive and negative oracle controls with zero model calls.

memory-restart requests include existing original-input anchors, validating continuity supplied jointly by summaries, history, and persisted state. task-chain focuses on execution relationships; the next section validates artifact bytes and tool effects.

## Tools and artifacts

```sh
node --import tsx test_case/online/test-api-v1-artifacts-live.ts --self-check
node --import tsx test_case/online/test-api-v1-artifacts-live.ts --live --evidence '<全新私密目录>'
```

The model first writes a program computing `sum([17,25])`, then continues the same task, reads the first result, and runs a second program to double it. Test scope covers two specified program writes and exact Python commands; code, directories, timeout, and approval display_hash are checked before execution.

Each round publishes a program and JSON artifact. Acceptance downloads all four files through the API, verifies length, ETag, SHA-256, ownership, and unchanged first-round content after continuation. An independent oracle computes from downloaded bytes and reruns downloaded programs in a new directory; actual read and shell outputs are also checked. TaskResult.verified_by remains the product’s NOT_VERIFIED; host verification is recorded separately.

## Other scenarios

`test-issue21-28-live.ts` jointly validates removal of old inputs and history retrieval. Use a self-provisioned isolated PG test DSN, existing `SECRETARY_CREDENTIALS_FILE`, and a new private `SECRETARY_LIVE_EVIDENCE` directory; real-data instances must not be test DSNs. It calls opencode-go/deepseek-v4.1-flash for 24 synthetic conversation turns plus one material-pressure turn, then actively searches background facts and cites original events after routine compaction, Settings, and reopening. Checks confirm facts are absent from actual requests and transport, working memory/ledger do not cache answers, the latest correction and another unchanged constraint still hold, and originals remain readable.

Defaults: at most 100 physical sends and 40 minutes, 90 seconds per request. `SECRETARY_LIVE_MAX_CALLS` / `SECRETARY_LIVE_WALL_MS` can tighten budgets. `SECRETARY_LIVE_RESUME_STORE` applies only to this script’s isolated synthetic Store after 24 completed turns; it rechecks original replies before finishing acceptance, without rewriting provenance or preloading search answers. Each run records its own counts and source hashes; continuation reports accumulate calls and preserve the first failure. See the [execution record](../../../fix/archive/fix_20261012_issue21_28_记忆检索与旧输入有界退出.md#13-实施记录) for the 2026-10-13 joint result.

| Entry point | Purpose |
| --- | --- |
| npm run test:live | End-to-end flow, missing information, unknown outcomes, transport, and refusal scenarios |
| npm run test:task-reuse:live | O01–O06 multi-round edits, explanations, reopened continuations, and specified report artifacts |
| npm run test:instructions:live | Model behavior under active instructions |
| npm run test:continuity:live | Five synthetic logical days, fact/language continuity, and settings changes |
| test-settings-live.ts / verify-memory-live.ts | World, settings, and memory probes on a specified isolated Store |

continuity allows at most 24 requests and 15 minutes, 90 seconds per request, 8192 output tokens, and 80000 context bytes; it calls only the main model and reopens within the same OS process. task-reuse defaults to at most 48 model calls per role, 100 tool calls, and 12 minutes; writes are limited to the specified report file.

Early activity/streaming browser-driving scripts were retired in PR3b; reproduce them at their pinned historical version. `test-streaming-live.ts` moved to API v1 message commands, sync SSE, and timeline queries; that change only migrated protocol and checked types, with live-model validation assigned to PR3c. Current API-specific entry points are test-api-v1-live, api-v1-online-worker, and test-api-v1-artifacts-live.

## Reports and retries

Reports retain source hashes, configuration scope, request counts, first-run failures, and later independent runs. SDK catalog costs are estimates; missing usage is marked separately. Raw requests, responses, and credentials stay private. Public summaries are in the [API validation record](../../../api/v1/verification.md), which preserves actual 2026-10-10 results.

The default API script supports `--memory-settings-only`; `--retry-compaction-from` copies the synthetic Store from a specified failed directory of this script into a new directory and retries compaction. Set remaining budgets with SECRETARY_ONLINE_ATTEMPT_BUDGET and SECRETARY_ONLINE_TOTAL_MS on reruns, preserving the original failure. Scripts validate acceptable errors and parameters.
